label: Plain Hem 7.6 cm
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: It confirms the plain (uncuffed) hem family - there is no turn-up on either leg. It cannot confirm the option's defining quantity: a 7.6 cm hem ALLOWANCE is the folded-under depth on the inside of the leg, which no exterior worn shot can show, and there is no ruler, scale or interior view. The hem occupies only a few percent of the frame.
references.ownerNotes:
If the red line represents a 7 cm plain hem turn-up (inside fold allowance), the drafting is straightforward.

Plain Hem Construction

Let:

FH = finished hem depth
HA = hem allowance

For a plain trouser hem:

HA=FHHA = FH

If the hem allowance shown is 7 cm:

HA=7 cmHA = 7\text{ cm}
Drafting

At the trouser bottom:

Draw the finished hem line.
Measure 7 cm downward.
Draw the cut line.
Fold up the full 7 cm allowance and stitch blind or machine hem.

references.evidence: Plain, cuffless hems are visible so the hem STYLE is consistent, but the composition is a whole-trouser product shot centred on the waist and front rather than the hem. The 7.6 cm allowance is an interior fold depth and is nowhere shown, measured or implied.
